scope: Read-only retained-focus audit; no new UI implementation or device acceptance
implemented_and_preserved: ChatEntryPresentation is entry ViewModel over session-owned ChatTurnController; clears on lock/pop.
ChatViewModel preserves transcript anchor by canonical message ID and offset; explicit latest action avoids forced scroll.
DraftComposerState obtains text/selection from encrypted SessionDraftStore; IME composition range remains memory-local and is not persisted.
gaps: ChatBottomBar has no FocusRequester or retained focus/scene identity hook. Spec AL10 explicitly requires one requestFocus after scene move only when prior intent still eligible.

SkeinWorkspaceHost activates pane from focus; a blind composer autofocus can steal active pane or dismiss intended dialog/overlay focus. Any implementation must bind to current workspace and visible route, not generic composition lifecycle.
Caret storage does not prove focus or real IME continuity. Existing host representation and screenshots cannot satisfy the physical focus/IME criterion.
verification_contract: Use content-free ephemeral focus intent in existing entry/session owner; clear on explicit blur, entry disposal and lock.

Compose test same retained entry through source navigation and repeated size/pane flips; preserve text/selection/scroll, request once per eligible move. Include inactive pane, drawer/dialog, user blur, restored locked navigation, closed entry negative cases.
Run focused host UI tests and unchanged screenshot checks; record actual device IME geometry and owner synthetic flow only on verified installed source.
